Ab initio model potentials (AIMP) listed below were obtained in a
self-consistent embedding ion (SCEI) calculation on the original
Cs2ZrCl4 crystal.[1]
The following computational details were used:
ANO-RCC-VDZP for the main atoms and for the first coordinated ones
Individual clusters were built for Cs, Zr and Cl ions, in which these
elements are placed at the origin of the coordinates.
Three layers of AIMP potentials accounted for the surrounding atoms.
Ten layers of point charges simulated the remaining crystal:
Cs = +1;  Zr = +4; and Cl = -1;
The obtained molecular orbitals and density of the central element
were used to fit the AIMP potential for each element, and were used in
the subsequent SCEI iteration. The entire procedure convergerged in
about 12-15 SCEI iterations for all elements.
The potentials listed below are in the format of Seward program in MOLCAS
package[2].
Refs:
